summary: InMode Ltd. filed a 6-K attaching a letter from its Special Committee providing an update on its review of two acquisition proposals: one from a group including CEO Meir Shamir, and one from Steel Partners Holdings L.P. to acquire 100% of the company. The committee, composed of three independent directors, was formed to evaluate these proposals and will recommend a path to the board. No terms (price, premium, dates) or advisors are disclosed yet. Shareholders will vote on any recommended transaction. Watch for competing bids, negotiation developments, and potential future definitive agreement terms.
